summary: Released the Gemini API CLI ( gemini-api ), a stateless, zero-dependency command-line client for AI coding agents, scripts, and CI pipelines. Use gemini-api on the Interactions API to generate text and media, analyze files, and run Gemini managed agents . See the Gemini API CLI guide to get started.
